## Montagio · Keyframe hook (Ignite)

A hook in one graph: Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 (4 steps) makes the end frame, the photo engulfed in flames, then Wan 2.2 FLF2V animates the way from the photo to it.

**Tip:** Change the edit instruction and the motion text together: the first says where the clip ends, the second how it gets there.

**Models**, under `ComfyUI/models/`:
- `vae/qwen_image_vae.safetensors` (Apache-2.0, from Qwen/Qwen-Image)
- `diffusion_models/qwen_image_edit_2511_fp8mixed.safetensors` (Apache-2.0, from Qwen/Qwen-Image-Edit-2511)
- `text_encoders/qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled.safetensors` (Apache-2.0, from Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct)
- `loras/Qwen-Image-Edit-2511-Lightning-4steps-V1.0-bf16.safetensors` (Apache-2.0, from lightx2v/Qwen-Image-Edit-2511-Lightning)
- `diffusion_models/wan2.2_i2v_high_noise_14B_fp8_scaled.safetensors` (Apache-2.0, from Wan-AI/Wan2.2-I2V-A14B)
- `text_encoders/umt5_xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled.safetensors` (Apache-2.0, from google/umt5-xxl)
- `vae/wan_2.1_vae.safetensors` (Apache-2.0, from Wan-AI/Wan2.1-I2V-14B-480P)
- `diffusion_models/wan2.2_i2v_low_noise_14B_fp8_scaled.safetensors` (Apache-2.0, from Wan-AI/Wan2.2-I2V-A14B)
- `loras/wan2.2_i2v_lightx2v_4steps_lora_v1_high_noise.safetensors` (Apache-2.0, from lightx2v/Wan2.2-Lightning)
- `loras/wan2.2_i2v_lightx2v_4steps_lora_v1_low_noise.safetensors` (Apache-2.0, from lightx2v/Wan2.2-Lightning)

Core nodes only. Edit 20 to 25 s warm, transition 134 to 157 s (4 steps) on an NVIDIA L4 (24 GB).

Open weights only: every file is Apache-2.0 or MIT, pinned by sha256 in Montagio's `registry/models.lock.yaml`.
